extraction_notes: Table 1 entries 14–19 were excluded because they are literature data with external references, not measurements from this paper. Figure 2a duplicates Table 1 TOF values, so the printed table values were used. Arrhenius, reaction-order, isotope-exchange, relative-activity, DFT, and selectivity plots were not extracted as catalyst-performance rate/outlet-NH3/TOF records; Figure 1a non-tabulated rate points were read approximately from the plotted axis.
